department: Lane Department of Computer Science and Electrical Engineering

deadline.value: Fall application deadline is April 1, 2027 on the graduate school's program page.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required for admission and for assistantship consideration; the requirement can be waived for listed ABET or top-ranked programs with a 3.2 GPA.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores. GRE scores are required for admission and to be considered for graduate assistantships | The GRE requirement can be waived for students from

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog and department page do not say whether a faculty member must agree to advise before admission.

funding.value: The department's main support is the graduate teaching assistantship; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: The primary source for financial support within the department is the Graduate Teaching Assistantship

entry_route.value: The EE PhD requires an appropriate master's degree; the computer engineering PhD also accepts a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: All applicants require an appropriate master's degree for entry

also.quote: All applicants for the doctoral program require an appropriate bachelor's or master's degree for entry

notes: Covers the Electrical Engineering and Computer Engineering PhDs. Waiver conditions include ABET programs or QS top-ranked institutions with a 3.2 GPA.
